```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 13_related_t_designs
title: >
  Think of Designs
questions:
  - id: related_designs
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Think of one independent-samples design and one related-samples design for the
      same broad research question.
    answerLabel: Example answer
    answer: >
      A good answer contrasts different people in each treatment condition with the
      same people measured in multiple conditions or carefully matched pairs.
    explanation: >
      Each row in the related-samples data must represent one person measured
      twice or one deliberately matched pair. Two groups with similar average
      ages aren't enough; we need to know which scores belong together.
```
